name: Features Permissions
description: Creates exportable permission config entities from roles for Features.
project_description:
The Features Permissions module allows for permissions to be managed (exported/imported) by the Features module.

 Drupal attaches permissions to roles. When a role is exported, all permissions are exported with the role. If a role is included in a feature, then all permissions for that role are included in that feature. In many instances this is not desirable. As a result, permissions are stripped by default when exporting roles.

 The Features Permissions module provides a permission config entity type (user_permission, stored as features_permissions.permission.*) that is synced with roles. When a role entity is updated, the associated permission entities are also updated. This allows for exportability. When a permission entity is imported or reverted by Features, the associated roles are also updated. Each permission entity records the machine name, the human-readable permission key, and the list of roles that hold it.
